Also: default seed is random.js's scatter() (nondeterministic) — pinned seed:()=>{} for a blank deterministic root.

1. split into columns — steps: 1.open /probe/ at 1280 (blank root leaf) 2.hover root, click .panel-edge-r, click again off-edge to commit -> divide('row') 3.hover new right col, click .panel-edge-b, commit -> divide('col'). WORKS: tree = row[leaf, col[leaf,leaf]] exactly as expected, seams visible, grow=1 fills. Path: real UI edge-click gesture (page.evaluate only to read the tree back). png: flex-01-split.png

2. add a third column — steps: 1.read grow(colA)=1 grow(colB)=1 2.hover colA, click its right edge, commit -> divide('row') fast-paths a sibling insert (same-dir parent) 3.read after. WORKS, and answers the owner's question: grow values UNCHANGED (1,1,1) — the new column does not steal a specific neighbour's grow, it just makes the split 3-way even (rendered widths 310/310/310px at 1280, was 50/50 before). Path: real UI edge-click. png: flex-02-add-column.png

3. resize a seam by dragging — steps: 1.read grow(colA)=1 grow(mid)=1 2.pointerdown on the .panel-grip between them 3.10x pointermove +20px right (200px total) 4.pointerup 5.split colB again to force a redraw 6.re-read. WORKS: grow -> colA=1.645 mid=0.355, and PERSISTS through the later split (same values after). Path: real pointerdown/move/up. png: flex-03-resize.png

3b. same tree at 400px — grips measured 0px in their flow dimension (by design per grip.css: zero-width in flow, the real hit target is an absolutely-positioned overlay strip, not the flow box) so this is a measurement caveat, not a confirmed defect — did not verify with an actual click-drag at 400px, logging the miss. No horizontal overflow at 400 (.app sw=cw=400, 0/5 panel bodies over). png: flex-03-resize-400.png

4. display:flex + 3 templates — steps: 1.evaluate mid.divide('col') nests (parent dir=row mismatch) -> mid=col-split[m1,m2] 2.evaluate m2.divide('col') fast-paths a 3rd sibling m3 3.evaluate mid.set('display','flex'); m1/m2/m3 templates = logos/hero/changelog (small/large/long) 4.hover+scan toolbar for a row<->col direction control. RESULT: display=flex applied, overlay renders (on by default per display.js); NO direction-toggle control found in the toolbar — divide()'s dir is fixed at creation, so 'row -> column direction' is not offered as the requirements.md hedged it might not be. Path: evaluate for structure (toolbar's Display/Template pops are hover-revealed popovers, time-boxed past — logging the miss on the UI path). png: flex-04-display-flex.png

5. fill vs hug on one axis — steps: 1.evaluate colA.set('w','hug'); template='logos' (short) 2.measure colA/mid widths 3.evaluate colA.set('template','changelog') (long) 4.re-measure + check body scrollWidth/clientWidth. Likely cause: changelog stacks vertically rather than being intrinsically wide, so it never tested the width axis — a better pair (e.g. a template with one long unbroken word/string) would be more conclusive; flagging size.js `extents()` (size.js ~line 26) as worth a closer look rather than calling it broken. Path: evaluate (toolbar's Width popover not driven). png: flex-05-fill-hug.png

6. nest three deep + sow — steps: 1.evaluate b1.divide('row') nests (parent colB dir=col, mismatch) -> root>colB>b1 = 3 deep 2.evaluate generate.js's sow(b1a, 12345) — the bar's space_dashboard verb, called directly since its button is behind a hover-reveal 3.screenshot at 1280 4.resize to 400, screenshot again. WORKS: 3-deep tree confirmed; sow rolled a real generated layout (37 panel bodies). .app itself never overflows at either width (sw==cw both 1280 and 400) — it reflows. BUT 31/37 panel bodies overflow their own box at 1280 and 33/37 at 400 (scrollWidth>clientWidth) — individual generated cells clip/scroll internally at both sizes, worth the strategy minion's attention even though the page itself never breaks. Path: UI edge-clicks (nesting) + evaluate (sow). png: flex-06-nest-1280.png, flex-06-nest-400.png
